login.title: Member sign in
login.subtitle: Sign in with the email you joined the club with.
login.accessSubtitle: First time here, or forgot your password? Enter your club email and we will send you a link to set one.
login.firstTime: First time, or forgot your password?
login.sentText: If {{email}} belongs to a club member, a link to set your password is on its way. It works once and expires soon.
login.membersOnly: The member area is for AFAQ members. Not a member yet? Apply from the Join Us page.

errors.invalid: That email and password do not match. First time here? Ask for a password link below.
errors.failed: Sign in failed. Try again in a moment.
errors.notMember: This account is not linked to an active club member.
errors.tooMany: Too many requests. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.network: Cannot reach the server. Check your connection.

setPassword.title: Choose your password
setPassword.subtitle: You will use it with your club email to sign in.
setPassword.invalid: This link has expired or was already used. Ask for a new one.

errors.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
errors.same: Choose a password different from your old one.
errors.failed: The password was not saved. Ask for a new link and try again.
errors.tooMany: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.

setPassword.temporary: You signed in with a temporary password. Choose your own password to continue.

home.rankNote: Ranks compare your points with active members; other members' points stay private.

points.empty: No points yet. Take part in events and tasks to earn some.

achievements.maxTier: Top tier reached. You are a legend.
achievements.xpNote: XP is every point you have earned. Penalties lower it; resets of the points table do not.
achievements.cardsNote: Pick the card shown at the top of this page. Higher tiers unlock rarer designs, and club offices unlock their own.
achievements.framesNote: Pick the frame around your photo in the member area.
achievements.badgesNote: Bronze, silver and gold: take part in events, finish tasks and help out to level them up.
achievements.privateNote: Your card and frame are shown in your member area only and are saved on this device.

tierLines.rookie: Every great project starts with a first step.
tierLines.explorer: You are finding your way around the club.
tierLines.builder: You show up and you make things happen.
tierLines.innovator: Your ideas move the club forward.

share.title: Share your progress
share.error: The image could not be made. Try again.
share.note: The image shows your name, photo, member number and points. Share it only where you want them seen.
share.motmLine: The most active member of AFAQ Scientific Club in {{month}}.
share.shareText: My AFAQ Scientific Club status: {{tier}}, {{xp}} XP.
share.motmShareText: Member of the month at AFAQ Scientific Club, {{month}}!

result.ok: You are registered. The team will confirm your place.
result.duplicate: You are already registered for this event.
result.closed: Registration for this event has closed.
result.unavailable: This event is no longer available.
result.failed: The registration did not go through. Try again.

tasks.note: Tasks your team leads assigned to you. Points are added when a task is marked done.

profile.name: Full name

profile.emails: Email me club news and event notifications
profile.saveFailed: Your changes were not saved. Try again.
profile.cardNote: Scanning this code confirms your membership.
profile.passwordNote: Choose a new password for your member account.
profile.photoNote: Your photo appears on your member card. A new photo is checked by the HR team before anyone sees it.
profile.photoRefused: Your last photo was not accepted: {{note}}

photoErrors.too_big: That image is too large. Try another photo.
photoErrors.bad_file: Choose a JPG, PNG or WebP photo.
photoErrors.failed: The photo was not sent. Try again.
photoErrors.tooMany: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.

profile.shownNameHint: Pick the words of your name to use in greetings and emails. Your full name stays on your card.

card.error: The card could not be drawn. Reload the page and try again.
card.notValid: Your card is not active right now, so it will not verify. Contact the HR team.
card.note: Show the barcode at club events to check in and get your points. The QR code proves your membership to anyone who scans it.
card.showHint: Turn your screen brightness up and hold the phone steady under the scanner. Tap anywhere to close.
